modes.description: Whisper Small with greedy decoding and speaker identification; word times from Whisper; quality checks flag doubtful passages. Quickest; less accurate on difficult audio.
modes.label: Fast

modes.description: Whisper Large-v3 Turbo with beam search where the backend supports it, speaker identification, forced word alignment and quality checks.
modes.label: Balanced

modes.description: Whisper Large-v3 with beam search where supported (float32 on the CPU backend), speaker identification, forced word alignment, quality checks, and re-transcription of doubtful passages with the wording chosen by acoustic evidence. Slowest.
modes.label: Maximum Accuracy
modes.limitations: Wordings are compared acoustically only in languages an installed word-alignment model supports; elsewhere, differing wordings are listed for review instead.
